subject.title: [Feature Request] Auto-linkify URLs in tool output cards (Control UI & WebChat)

question: Should this issue close only after both Control UI and native WebChat tool output support safe clickable URLs, or should it be narrowed to a Control UI-first fix with native parity tracked separately?
rationale: The Control UI repair shape is clear, but the issue title and body include native WebChat, so automation should not decide whether a web-only implementation satisfies the broader request.

options.title: Narrow to Control UI first
options.body: Implement and prove complete Control UI tool-output linkification now, then split native WebChat parity into a follow-up if maintainers still want it.

options.title: Require full parity
options.body: Keep this issue open until both Control UI and native WebChat render safe clickable links in tool output cards.

options.title: Make WebChat out of scope
options.body: Treat the request as web-only and close it after the Control UI behavior is implemented and proven.

recommendation.title: Narrow to Control UI first
recommendation.body: Implement and prove complete Control UI tool-output linkification now, then split native WebChat parity into a follow-up if maintainers still want it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the clearest owner from current UI history and prior scope review on this issue.
